chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh narrated to me from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn Marid, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'No believer has a milking goat in his home but that the people of that house will be made holy and blessed. If there are two, they will be made holy and blessed twice every day.'

And some of our companions asked, 'How will they be made holy?' He said: 'An angel will stand by them every morning and evening and say: You have been made holy and blessed, you have become pure, and your food has become pure.'

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of keeping a milking goat in the home according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the spiritual merit of maintaining a milking goat, noting that its presence sanctifies the household, with the blessing occurring twice daily if two goats are kept. This daily purification is announced by an angel who proclaims their holiness and the purity of their sustenance, reflecting the Shia tradition that simple, lawful provisions contribute to the spiritual cleanliness (taharah) of the home.
